name: repomind
description: RepoMind — local-first engineering intelligence for using free DeepSeek Web on real repositories.
author: cyb3rl00m

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repomind/engine && npm run build -w @repomind/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
